features.text: PROFESSIONAL-GRADE SUPPORT: Delivers medical-level stabilization for post-op and chronic lumbar conditions.
ADVANCED SIDE PANELS: Allow precision adjustment for targeted compression and spinal alignment.
LIGHTWEIGHT BREATHABLE FABRIC: Designed for all-day comfort and extended wear.
OPTIONAL ANTERIOR PAD: Enhances immobilization and reduces disc stress.
UNIVERSAL CONFIGURATION: Fits waist sizes 23-66 inches with optional extension belt.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
